Name: CSS' Good Luck Haley - A Haley Pre-Marriage Dialogue Expansion Mod
Author: ClairesStoryofSeasons
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Fz3L6x14/GLH-BANNER-removebg-preview.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/center]
[center][/center]
Are you a female farmer who just cannot resist starting a new save just to romance Haley after hearing Chappell Roan’s [i]Good Luck Babe[/i]? Are you a new player who installed Stardew Valley over that [i]one Tiktok edit[/i]?  Alternatively, do you headcanon her as sapphic, and wish for a dialogue mod that alludes to this?

Or, have you received Haley's iconic "eww" after inviting her to dance at the Flower Dance and said to yourself, "haha, that's wifey right there lol xD"? Well, this mod hopes to extend some love for our female farmers who can't help but romance Haley in every chance they get.
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/VNsGqJvX/features-(1).png[/img]

Inspired by Chappell Roan's [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xCh1T6fcRo8][i]Good Luck, Babe! [/i][/url](and that one TikTok edit), [font=Lucida Sans Unicode][color=#f4f4f4]Good Luck, Haley![/color][/font][color=#6d9eeb] [/color]is a pre-marriage dialogue expansion mod that features 200+ new and tweaked seasonal, pre-festival, pre-marriage (from years 1 to 2), and dating lines tailored for the female farmer. [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img]The purpose behind this is to make your relationship and her dialogue progressive as the days and seasons go by.

[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS][u]What's new with Good Luck Haley 2.0?[/u] [/font][/size]
[/color][/b]
◦ 200 new and altered lines (including new dialogue lines, edited dialogue, and item gift responses)
◦ A cute dating cutscene [img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img] (Disclaimer: the event will [b]not [/b]trigger if you are dating, engaged, or married to Emily)
◦ Included an internationalization (i18n) framework for seamless translation with other languages
◦ Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23536]Hearty Haley[/url]
[center][/center]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/prB5JLpG/disclaimer.png[/img]

This dialogue mod can technically be used by any farmer (regardless of your gender or orientation), but was primarily designed and curated for the perspective of the female farmer. As with any mod, this won't appeal to everyone, and that is completely okay. If it doesn't align with your interpretation of Haley or your preferences, feel free to pass on this one. You do you.

This mod also attempts to capture her struggle with her identity, her blossoming feelings for the female farmer, and even her quiet moments of vulnerability that reveal that she is more than just the "mean girl" that people might assume her to be. This mod is part of a plethora of dialogue mods that add variety to Haley's character.

[center][/center]
[left][img]https://i.postimg.cc/25CJ0Hc1/installation-(1).png[/img][/left]

Download the ZIP file and extract its contents into your Mods folder. Manual installation of this mod is recommended. Make sure all required files are installed. 

Note: Good Luck Haley requires Content Patcher 2.7.0 or higher versions. For other issues, please make sure to include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] (and any relevant information) so that I may know how to address your problem.
[center][/center]
[left][b][color=#fff2cc][size=5][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Xq2d0v44/compatibility.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/left]

[list]
[*]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23536]Hearty Haley[/url]. If both of these other mods are installed, you may set the value settings to Random (via GMCM or manually editing it in the config.json). This basically tells the game to flip a coin for either Good Luck Haley or these mods' lines to appear when dialogue keys overlap. [/*]
[*]This mod is compatible with SVE and RSV. By using RSV, this mod provides exclusive lines for Haley.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]﻿. Set 'CFE_Haley' to "random" in the config, thereby allowing both mods to coexist without issue.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]This mod is compatible with[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059] Diverse[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059] Stardew Valley[/url]﻿ - Emily (They/Them). [/*]
[/list][list]
[*]This mod is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18887]Emily the Mixologist[/url]﻿. When used in GLH, this mod provides exclusive lines for Haley.[/*]
[/list]
Other dialogue mods that alter Haley's pre-marriage dialogue or lore [i]may [/i]conflict with this mod. Requests for compatibility in future updates will be [u]subject to my discretion[/u]

.[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Z5mHFWnF/supported-languages-(1).png[/img]

[/list]For mod translators, I am open to having my mods translated, provided that you [font=Lucida Sans Unicode][u]ask me permission first[/u]. [/font]Translations for this mod published without prior authorization are NOT allowed and will be taken down accordingly. For inquiries, you may message me on NexusMods so you can get my Discord [color=#f4f4f4](preferably).[/color]

[line]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#fff2cc][size=5][font=Trebuchet MS]‧₊˚❀༉‧₊˚. AUTHOR'S NOTES & CREDITS ‧₊˚❀༉‧₊˚.[/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]

Hey everyone!  [i]Finallyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy[/i], Good Luck Haley 2.0 is here! I can't even imagine how surreal it feels to finally publish an update to this mod.[img]https://i.postimg.cc/D07qL5vs/hearts.png[/img]

First and foremost, I'd like to sincerely apologize for the longgggggggggg delay it took me to update this mod. I originally published this mod in 2024 as a passion project.  As some of you may know, I have a pretty busy schedule, and modding Stardew Valley is a way for me to destress and create art outside of my academic field. Law school kept on wrecking any sense of time and energy that I had in maintaining my mods. Outside of my small circle of author friends, it may seem like I disappeared while still teasing things here and there. I’m truly sorry for that but I swear, I really was working on it (slowly but surely).

I will say, though, that seeing people install Good Luck Haley and speak its praises (despite the lack of updates) made me happy and incentivized me to work on its completion. To everyone who was patient with me, helped me, and encouraged me despite all of the odds, this one is for you. I'm honestly just really relieved that it's finally here, and I just hope that it's worth the wait for my mod users.

I'd like to extend my appreciation to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS?gameId=1303]Airyn [/url]for helping me set compatibility with his mods and being so patient in teaching me about Dynamic Tokens, and to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Scarlett28?gameId=1303]Scarlett [/url]for playtesting Good Luck Haley. I'd also like to shout out the amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZhenShenius?gameId=1303]Shen[/url], my Russian translator for Good Luck Haley and Harvey Cares, for their work in helping me catch this mod's bugs and providing the screenshots for this mod's preview. Finally, I'd like to send my appreciation to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/tottlesfarm/about-me?gameId=1303]tottlesfarm[/url] for allowing me to set up compatibility with their lovely mod, Hearty Haley.

This also goes without saying but I'd like to extend my gratitude to [url=https://www.instagram.com/chappellroan/?hl=en]Chappell Roan[/url], whose song inspired me to make this mod.

As a queer woman myself, I tried my best to reflect on our struggles, especially when it came to accepting and embracing our identity and sexual orientation. Personally, this would not have been possible for me if not for the people who embraced me for who I am, having a loving community, the privilege of consuming inclusive media and books, and talking to people who opened up my worldview and beliefs.
